results.content: ## Technovation. # Business model innovation in traversing developed and emerging economies: An integrated systematic literature review. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.technovation.2025.103348Get rights and content. BM Reinnovation occurs from emerging market innovations. Business model innovation (BMI) is a complex phenomenon, made even more so in the international landscape involving emerging economies. This paper departs from the usual entity-based ontology of BMI to a more process-based ontology that highlights the nuances of innovation in and with business models as the role of business model innovation in a bifurcated world of developed and emerging economies is addressed. The midpoint (i.e., intervention and mechanisms) of the story contains rich and nuanced developments involving firm capabilities and knowledge management initiatives in addressing emerging economy innovation and reverse innovation. This work contributes to the research on business models by showing that the concept is more nuanced, as notions of innovation-enabling business models and business model reinnovation are explored. ## Data availability. No data was used for the research described in the article.
